plan.title: eRFX stage panel remains usable after deleting Auction

steps.note: Open the eRFX project create screen.
Provide the required event title for the create flow.
Confirm the initial project contains exactly the default Auction stage.
Open the Add Stages menu to add Technical Stage.
Verify Technical Stage is available to add.
Add the Technical Stage while retaining Auction.
Confirm both Technical Stage and Auction are present before deletion.
Open the Auction stage overflow menu so it can be deleted.
Delete the Auction stage as required by the scenario.
Confirm only the Technical Stage remains after deletion.
Open the remaining Technical Stage panel.
Verify the remaining stage panel is rendered and not blank.
Verify Technical Stage controls and content were not lost.
Confirm no application error appeared during stage deletion or panel navigation.
